newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania T-bill yield falls to 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania T-bill yield falls to 34 pct.

text.p: Yields for Romanian three-month treasury bills sank to 34 percent at Thursday's auction from 42 percent in the previous session, central bank (BNR) data showed.
The finance ministry issue of 773.8 billion lei in rollover bills was heavily oversubscribed with 19 participants bidding a total 2.2 trillion lei.

The entire T-bills issue, placed through a Dutch style auction, were bought by commercial banks. Their bids ranged between 30.89 percent to 70 percent. In recent weeks, the money market has been overliquid as the BNR sip up the dollar excess to prevent the leu from firming.
The BNR dollar purchases flooded the money market with leu funds, triggering a fall in interest rates below 50 percent, compared with about 190 percent in early April.
